description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified vulnerability scheduled scan policy and returns the complete updated configuration
description_zh: 修改指定漏洞定时扫描策略的配置，并返回修改后的完整配置
name: UpdateVulScanScheduledStrategy

parameters.example: 研发部门每周漏洞扫描
parameters.help_en: The policy name. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文、大小写英文字母、数字及半角句点（.）、下划线（_）、连字符（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端执行漏洞扫描
parameters.name: strategy_description

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: The policy takes effect on all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: The policy takes effect only on users in specified user groups. In this case, UserGroupIds is required
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效，此时UserGroupIds必填
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: by day.
week: by week
parameters.help_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周
parameters.name: scan_frequency

parameters.help_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle. This parameter works together with ScanFrequency to determine the trigger cycle. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
parameters.help_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。取值范围：1~30。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次
parameters.name: scan_interval

parameters.help_en: The start hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is an integer hour. Valid values: 0 to 23, inclusive. This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is an integer hour. Valid values: 1 to 24, exclusive. The value must be greater than ScanBeginTime. This field is not a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。本字段不是时间戳
parameters.name: scan_end_time

parameters.help_en: The list of exempted users. Users in this list are not scanned by this policy. The list can contain up to 1000 entries and duplicates are not allowed. This parameter performs a full overwrite. The list you specify replaces the existing list of the policy
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。最多包含1000个，不允许重复。本参数为全量覆盖，传入的名单会替换该策略原有的名单
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The collection of user group IDs for the effective scope. This parameter is required when the effective scope is UserGroupNormal and must not be specified when the effective scope is UserGroupAll. The collection must contain at least 1 and at most 100 entries, and duplicates are not allowed. The collection you specify fully replaces the existing user groups of the policy
parameters.help_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。生效范围为UserGroupNormal时必填，为UserGroupAll时不允许传入。至少包含1个，最多包含100个，不允许重复。传入的集合会全量替换该策略原有的用户组
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vulnerability scheduled scan policy to modify. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~): Lists vulnerability scheduled scan policies.
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~): Creates a vulnerability scheduled scan policy
parameters.help_zh:
待修改的漏洞定时扫描策略ID。取值来源：
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~)：批量查询漏洞定时扫描策略。
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~)：创建漏洞定时扫描策略
parameters.name: strategy_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the policy was created, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 策略创建时间，秒级Unix时间戳

CustomMatchGroup.description_en: The effective scope specified by organizational structure. An empty list is returned if the scope is not configured by organizational structure
CustomMatchGroup.description_zh: 按组织架构指定的生效范围。未按组织架构配置时返回空列表

Group.description_en: The collection of organizational structure nodes

items.description_en: The DN of the organizational structure node

LastTriggerTime.description_en: The time when the policy last triggered a scan, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp. The value 0 is returned if the policy has never been triggered
LastTriggerTime.description_zh: 策略最近一次触发扫描的时间，秒级Unix时间戳。从未触发过时返回0

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: The policy takes effect on all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: The policy takes effect only on users in specified user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效

MatchTargetIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs for the effective scope. An empty list is returned when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll
MatchTargetIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

Priority.description_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
Priority.description_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高。取值范围：1~100

ScanBeginTime.description_en: The start hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is an integer hour. Valid values: 0 to 23, inclusive. This field is not a timestamp
ScanBeginTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳

ScanEndTime.description_en: The end hour during which the scan can be triggered. The value is an integer hour. Valid values: 1 to 24, exclusive. The value must be greater than ScanBeginTime. This field is not a timestamp
ScanEndTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。本字段不是时间戳

ScanFrequency.description_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: by day.
week: by week
ScanFrequency.description_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周

ScanInterval.description_en: The interval number of the trigger cycle. This parameter works together with ScanFrequency to determine the trigger cycle. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week
ScanInterval.description_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。取值范围：1~30。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次

Status.description_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用

StrategyDescription.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端执行漏洞扫描

StrategyId.description_en: The vulnerability scheduled scan policy ID

StrategyName.example: 研发部门每周漏洞扫描

Whitelist.description_en: The list of exempted users. Users in this list are not scanned by this policy. An empty list is returned if no exemption is configured
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。未配置时返回空列表
